service.description: Checks if a component exists on disk and has its AI and Git prerequisites initialized.
Copies a framework or platform instruction file into the active target component at the identical mirrored relative path, establishing a domain-level override.
Scaffolds a new Moqui component directory structure on disk, generates component.xml, seeds AI blueprints, initializes a Git repository, and registers the root artifact.
Completely removes a target component from disk and database.
Fast micro-classifier for component elicitation. Analyzes raw narrative text and maps it to one of the 5 core application archetypes.
